correctness.rationale: Write G=τI+K with K²=κ²I, κ=sqrt(((a-d)/2)²+bc)>0. Consequently e^{Gt}=e^{τt}(coshκt I+(sinhκt/κ)K). Expanding D1=I-(1-s1)P1, D2=I-(1-s2)P2 in tr(e^{G(T-δ)}D2e^{Gδ}D1) and cycling yields Hδ=H0+B sinhκδ sinhκ(T-δ), B=(1-s1)(1-s2)bc e^{τT}/κ²>0. The determinant Δ=s1s2 exp((a+d)T)>0 is phase-independent. Positive monodromy entries imply positive distinct eigenvalues, so Perron root rises strictly with Hδ. Hyperbolic-product symmetry uniquely fixes the extrema. The threshold for Δ<1 is H=1+Δ, and Δ≥1 excludes decay. Independently computed e^{Gt} for 160 randomly generated matrices and verified exact rational example q=97/100, tr(0)=97/80, tr(T/2)=3977/3200, det=9409/40000, and opposite signs versus 1+det. This is a complete symbolic proof, not sampling inference.

originality.rationale: The qualitative benefit of synchronized pest treatment is known, as are Floquet methods for periodic impulses and synchrony results in certain SIR pulse vaccination models. The specific claim is the global all-parameter trace identity and exact phase ordering in a constant irreducible two-dimensional Metzler dispersal system with independently pulsed survival diagonals, including unequal growth/exchange/cull strengths. The examined relevant two-patch SI work and vaccination results use different state and pulse structures and do not imply this sharp formula.
